root_cause.text: The agp_amd64_probe() function incorrectly checks the return value of cache_nbs() against exactly -1 instead of any negative value, so when cache_nbs() returns -ENODEV (indicating no AMD northbridges), the error is ignored and the driver proceeds, leading to a NULL pointer dereference in amd64_fetch_size() when it tries to access node_to_amd_nb(0)->misc.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states "the probe function erroneously checks the return value against exactly -1, rather than < 0" and the patch changes `if (cache_nbs(pdev, cap_ptr) == -1)` to `if (cache_nbs(pdev, cap_ptr) < 0)`. The CVE description confirms that -ENODEV is returned but not caught, causing the subsequent crash in amd64_fetch_size().
